title: Rexonance 94件 再検証（作業中・全件合格ではない）
candidate: baseline + isolated working-tree patch; not integrated or published

gates.productionBuild: npm run prebuild + vite build; database migration intentionally not invoked
gates.operability: 8 Chromium profiles passed under explicitly labelled external-font outage
gates.callReturn: desktop + phone, 3 real SPA entries each passed
gates.interactionEdges: 5 profiles + slow image/artwork checks passed under explicitly labelled external-font outage

limitations: Google fonts/grok extension unavailable; controlled outage runs are explicitly labelled, not normal-online certification
Some older finding descriptions supplied by the user end mid-sentence; original wording retained
No publication or main integration yet

findings.claim: Every Japanese display line asks for palt, but the font has none, so headings set fixed-width kana with full-em gaps after 、 and 。 — src/styles-stage-special.css, src/styles-rexonance-forge.css, src/styles-rexonance-saga.css
findings.note: ローカルMinchoを実描画し、同一文字列64pxの幅がpalt OFF 768px→ON 618.625px。『フォントにpaltがない』は現行に該当しない。

findings.claim: The chapter 03 (suit-up) heading is outside the type system: the eyebrow is 14px Noto body text, the H2 is 48px/26px without palt or keep-all, and a g — src/styles-rexonance-editorial.css, src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-assembly-guide.tsx, src/styles-rexonance-type-20261021.css
findings.note: 装着章H2は他章と同じMincho・palt、1440で64.32px／1024で52.672px／390で40px。旧48/26px規則の単独支配ではない。

findings.claim: No type scale: 39 computed sizes, 19 Michroma size/weight/tracking combinations and 13 tracking values, defined in five font-token namespaces across a — src/styles-stage.css, src/styles-rexonance-saga.css, src/styles-showcase-elevation.css
findings.note: 現行TYPE版が6書体の役割・scale/tokenを明記。computed sizeの数だけを理由に、オーナー承認の役割分担を単一書式へ潰さない。

findings.claim: The chapter 03 opener breaks the chapter layout: no 03 numeral although the map lists one, its own gutter (x=56 vs 488/940), the 形態を見る button 1,300 px — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-assembly-guide.tsx, src/styles-rexonance-editorial.css, src/styles-rexonance-layout-20261021.css
findings.note: 03の大きな数字を省く旨がeditorialに明記され、最新layoutも承認済み。章番号はmap/ナビで維持。別の章配置案は提案事項。

findings.claim: The hero's first screen is a split HUD dashboard, not a film key visual: the name appears three times and the art fills about 35% of the screen — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx, src/styles-stage-rexonance.css, src/styles-rexonance-layout-20261021.css
findings.note: DESIGN_AUDIT.mdが1300px以上46:54の持続split stageを明記。『映画キービジュアルでない』という評価だけで承認構図を撤去しない。

findings.claim: One identical frame is pinned for about 8,400px, and the same artwork returns twice more — src/styles-stage-rexonance.css, src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx
findings.note: 同じ舞台を性能・P14の読み物と並べて保持することが最新layoutの決定。長さ・再利用の美的提案として残す。

findings.claim: iPad landscape hero: stacking the stage first pushes the H1 「究極が始まる。」 below the fold — src/styles-stage-rexonance.css, src/styles-saga-showcase.css, docs/cinematic-design-20260921.md

findings.claim: iPad portrait system grid renders three 238px columns with lines of about 13 Japanese characters — src/styles-stage-rexonance.css, src/styles-rexonance-saga.css

findings.claim: The footer CTAs show no focus indicator: the plates' clip-path cuts away the outline drawn 3px outside them, in forced colours too — src/styles-stage-rexonance.css, src/styles-showcase-elevation.css, src/styles-saga-showcase.css

findings.claim: 10-11px tracked Michroma and Japanese micro-labels at every width (chapter map, CONTENTS counter, FORM SEQUENCE/COMPARISON, form status, brand), under — src/styles-rexonance-editorial.css, src/styles-rexonance-saga.css, DESIGN.md

findings.claim: The hero CTAs '変身を体験' and '三つの形態を見る', '形態を見る' and the FORM COMPARISON bar have no hover, press or transition — src/styles-rexonance-editorial.css, src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-editorial.tsx, src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-assembly-guide.tsx
findings.note: hero/assembly/coda/比較barにscale160ms・translate220ms等の共通transitionを実測。『hover/press/transitionがない』は現行に該当しない。

findings.claim: The FORM COMPARISON drawer snaps open with no motion, pushing the page down 745 px in one frame — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-form-comparison.tsx, src/styles-rexonance-editorial.css
findings.note: native detailsと初回画像遅延・即時closeを維持。Chromiumのintrinsic-size対応時だけ有限280msで開く。3幅で23フレームを採取し、2→233→399→506→711pxなどの段階的な展開を確認。reduced/economy/forced coloursでは適用しない。非対応engineはnative動作。

findings.claim: LCP is the animated hero lede text (2.4-6.5 s on localhost); the 256 KB high-priority hero image never counts as LCP — src/styles-rexonance-premiere.css, src/styles-rexonance-resonance.css, src/routes/rexonance-saga.tsx
findings.note: 初回1440のLCPはIMG 740msで採取、旧lede text 2.4–6.5sという固定的な説明は再現しない。ただし外部フォント成功時・低速回線のLCP保証ではない。

findings.claim: The hero title sequence is rushed and unstaged: every beat finishes within about 1.4 s — src/styles-rexonance-premiere.css, src/lib/rexonance-choreography.js
findings.note: タイトルの高速な整列と長い変身を分ける現行choreography。『rushed』という好みだけで所有者の演出全体を遅らせない。

findings.claim: The hero kicker breaks as 'THE NEXT GENERATION / OF SA-GA', and the second line hangs back under the gold rule at the left margin — src/styles-saga-showcase.css, src/styles-rexonance-forge.css, src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx
findings.note: 320スクリーンショットでOF SA-GAは語内分断なしの2行目。現在はkicker-tailのまとまりを保持。

findings.claim: At 320 the stage tab 'ULTRA 60s' wraps to two lines while the other two tabs stay on one — src/styles-rexonance-editorial.css, src/styles-stage-rexonance.css
findings.note: 320のULTRA 60sコードの実ボックスは一行。タブ全体の日本語/英語二段組をコードの不規則折り返しとは扱わない。

findings.claim: Counters and step numbers use five faces (Forge, Michroma, Oxanium, Zen, Noto), and figures inside headlines use the display font's digits — src/styles-rexonance-forge.css, src/styles-rexonance-editorial.css
findings.note: 数値Forge、計器Etch、操作Zen、HUDの機能別役割を維持。全カウンターを同じfaceにするという美的統一は提案事項。

findings.claim: Symbols fall back out of their font stacks: arrows, the em dash, fullwidth ！, ∞ and 〜 render in Noto, Oxanium or Zen — src/lib/world-head.ts, src/styles-rexonance-forge.css
findings.note: external face成功時のglyph fallbackの特定が未完。Computed font-familyの文字列だけで実使用glyph faceを断定しない。

findings.claim: The 'DW' monogram fills its frame edge to edge — src/styles-rexonance-saga.css, src/styles-rexonance-type-20261021.css
findings.note: 共通DWモノグラムの変更はブランドと他ルートにも関係。ページ固有の不具合と断定せず提案に残す。

findings.claim: System cards 01/02/03 wrap their kickers and titles unevenly, so the body copy starts at three different heights — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx, src/styles-rexonance-instrument.css, src/styles-rexonance-forge.css
findings.note: Systemの見出し折り返しで読み始めがずれる。1100px以上をsubgridの共有3行へ変更。原文とカードの順序は無変更、 最終候補の3幅ブラウザーassertionに記録。

findings.claim: Chapter index: the fifth entry, 05, stretches across both columns, leaving its arrow about 1,000 px from the label — src/styles-rexonance-editorial.css
findings.note: 1100px以上の章mapは承認済みの1列5行。05だけ二列跨ぎで矢印が約1000px離れる旧配置ではない。

findings.claim: Stages section: the right column ends 125 px above the left, and the FORM COMPARISON bar floats in an empty band of about 450 px — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx, src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-form-comparison.tsx, src/styles-rexonance-editorial.css
findings.note: 現行の形態比較は閉じたnative disclosure barとして段落の後に置かれる。旧450px固定余白の規則は最新layoutで置換。個々の絵/説明の高さが異なること自体は残る。

findings.claim: The footer figure stands on the very last pixel row of the page, with no floor beneath it — src/styles-rexonance-instrument.css, src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx
findings.note: 終幕の立像はfooter内のtop50%/translate -50%、最大720pxへ最新layoutで置換。旧bottom0貼り付けではない。

findings.claim: Decorative pink streaks still show in forced-colours mode, where ornaments should be removed — src/styles-rexonance-armour.css, src/styles-rexonance-couture.css, src/styles-rexonance-resonance.css
findings.note: 原因はRexonance用CSSではなく共通body::beforeのSVG背景。ルートを限定して強制配色時に消し、通常のピンク装飾は維持。

findings.claim: Touch targets under the page's own minimum: P1比/P2比 at 42-44 px, the assembly and coda links and the scroll cue at 44 px — src/styles-p14-calibration.css, src/styles-rexonance-editorial.css, DESIGN.md
findings.note: 最新DESIGN_AUDIT.mdは44pxの操作面を明示的に保持。3幅で実高44pxであり、旧一般文書の48pxへ一律拡大しない。

findings.claim: At 320 the two hero CTAs stack at different widths (139px and 181px) — src/styles-rexonance-editorial.css, src/styles-saga-showcase.css
findings.note: 320pxのCTA幅差を確認。400px以下だけ同じ幅の縦組みへ変更。 最終候補の3幅ブラウザーassertionに記録。

findings.claim: Phone hints tell touch users to use 矢印キー (arrow keys) — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx, src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-editorial.tsx
findings.note: 現在の電話の説明は『スライダー、両端のタップ、矢印キー』という複数の操作方法。タッチを使えないと案内しているものではなく、キーボード代替も残す。

findings.claim: The stage tabpanel is itself aria-live while its children re-key, so every tab change re-reads the whole panel after the tab announcement — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx
findings.note: stage tabpanelから重複したaria-liveを除去。選択tabのaria-selectedとpanelのaria-labelledbyは保持。

findings.claim: The P1比 / P2比 focus ring is cut off on two sides by overflow:hidden on the range control — src/styles-p14-calibration.css
findings.note: P1/P2ボタンを実フォーカスし、輪郭をoverflow:hiddenの内側へ。通常・強制配色とも2px／-4px。

findings.claim: aria-label on elements without a role is ignored, so the bar-chart summaries and group names never reach assistive technology — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx
findings.note: 棒グラフのaria-labelにrole=img、比較コンソールと形態ボタン集合にはgroupを付け、名前を持てる要素へ。

findings.claim: Form-comparison buttons lose the form name when selected (「表示中の形態」) and use aria-pressed for a single-choice set — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-form-comparison.tsx
findings.note: 選択後も『マックスを表示中』として形態名を保持。単一選択のgroup内toggle buttonという既存操作は維持。aria-pressed自体を誤りとはしない。

findings.claim: Page chrome (brand, in-page nav, menu button) and the closing CTAs sit inside <main>, and the page has no banner or contentinfo landmark — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx
findings.note: 既存の配置を壊さず明示的banner/contentinfoを付与。実ブラウザーで各1ランドマークを確認。

findings.claim: Choosing a form in the FORM COMPARISON drawer changes a stage panel that is fully above the viewport, so the call, the panel change and the morph all — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-form-comparison.tsx, src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx
findings.note: カードで選択した後に、選択レールと結果パネルの先頭を固定ヘッダー下へ即時表示。キーボード操作では選択タブへフォーカスを戻す。

findings.claim: #assembly lands 7px below the sticky nav, against 24px for every other chapter — src/styles-rexonance-editorial.css, src/styles-rexonance-polish.css
findings.note: assemblyのscroll-marginだけreserve+12px。他章と同じreserve+24pxへ統一。 最終候補の3幅ブラウザーassertionに記録。

findings.claim: The System plates mix plain form (常体, plate 02) and polite form (敬体, plates 01 and 03) — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx
findings.note: 常体/敬体の統一は原文の書き換えになるため行わない。F64は役割の誤りの訂正として既存原稿を引用する。

findings.claim: In reduced-motion or economy mode, the replay bar still offers to replay by scrolling an animation the page has just said it skips — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-assembly-guide.tsx
findings.note: 動き削減・省エネでは『変身の資料を見る』へ変更し、再演出を案内する段落を隠す。メディア設定変更・root属性監視は解除処理を対にした。

findings.claim: The P14 baseline control is labelled 比較対象 on the range input but 比較基準 on the iOS select, and what it actually sets is the 100% baseline — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx
findings.note: rangeとiOS selectを『比較基準』へ統一。可視『基準にする世代』をselect名にも含め、100%基準というvalue textを保持。

findings.claim: Digit grouping is inconsistent within the same comparison rows — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx
findings.note: 6000m等は支給スペックの表記。誤値ではないため数値の桁区切りを理由に原文を変更しない。

findings.claim: The new hero slate names the base form 'STANDARD / HIGH', an internal key, while the page calls it レクソナンス / HIGH — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx
findings.note: 最新DESIGN_AUDIT.mdがスレート『01 STANDARD / HIGH · KEY VISUAL』を明記。監査を理由に勝手に別名へしない。

findings.claim: Hard seams between chapters: the stage ends in a flat cut straight into a solid band — src/styles-rexonance-layout-20261021.css, src/styles-stage-rexonance.css
findings.note: 最新layoutのstage/section seamを保持。溶け合う境界への改変は別の見た目案として残す。

findings.claim: The form panel's art ends in a hard edge across the shins — src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-saga.tsx, src/styles-rexonance-layout-20261021.css
findings.note: 現在のstageはobject-fit:containで支給画を表示。元絵の端を生成拡張せず、枠・portraitのowner artを保持。

findings.claim: The stage artwork is cropped at the crest tips, so the framed figure's helmet touches the frame edge — public/rider-rexonance-saga-pickup-20260923-delivery-1086.webp, src/lib/rexonance-images.ts
findings.note: containで元画像を全体表示しているため、crestに新しい画素を足す/絵を描き直す判断はしない。画像差し替え案として残す。

findings.claim: Pressing the already-active P14 pill flips it to solid white for the duration of the press (leftover :active rule from an earlier sheet) — src/styles-rexonance-finish.css, src/styles-p14-calibration.css
findings.note: P1選択中に実pointer downを採取。背景は押下前後とも同じ135deg gradientで、旧solid whiteへの反転は再現しない。

findings.claim: The footer CTA's hover lift, border fade and press scale snap instantly, because one sheet's transition list replaces the others — src/styles-rexonance-armour.css, src/styles-rexonance-saga.css, src/styles-rexonance-finish.css
findings.note: 終幕3CTAともscale160ms/translate220ms/background/border/shadow/color220msを実測。古いtransition上書きの説明は現行に該当しない。

findings.claim: In-page jumps smooth-scroll about 8,400 px through every scroll-driven scene — src/styles-world/01.css, src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-editorial.tsx, src/styles-rexonance-saga.css
findings.note: 共通htmlのsmooth-scrollで長距離も連続スクラブされる。Rexonance滞在中だけnative anchorを即時にし、hash/historyは維持。 最終候補の3幅ブラウザーassertionに記録。

findings.claim: The handover from the call to the page has no matching cut, and the hero then waits about 0.4-1.3 s for its own title — src/styles-rexonance-forge.css, src/components/rexonance-saga/rexonance-call-sequence.tsx, src/components/load-gate.tsx
findings.note: World→Rexonanceの毎フレーム記録ではcallがなくなった時点でH1 opacity=1。3幅で旧handover後0.4–1.3sの無表示は観測しない。

findings.claim: Motion timing and easing are not systematised: 54 duration values, 16 curves, and different hover and press behaviour on sibling controls — src/styles-rexonance-saga.css, src/styles-rexonance-finish.css, src/styles-rexonance-premiere.css
findings.note: 装着・カウント・hover・場面転換は異なる目的。duration/curve数の集計だけでownerの場面ごとの時計を一律化しない。

findings.claim: The P14 slider animates layout properties: the thumb's left and the fill's width — src/styles-p14-calibration.css, src/styles-rexonance-saga.css
findings.note: P14つまみのleftアニメーションをtranslateへ。端点のleftは23pxのまま、実際のxだけが移動することを確認。軌道のfillは現行では既に静的。
